snip.t: Recurrent prolonged episodes of priapism are associated with erectile dysfunction (impotence).
Sexual Dysfunction: Low serotonin is linked to issues like premature ejaculation and erectile dysfunction.
Erectile dysfunction: In young or middle-aged men with bilateral buttock claudication, screen for impotence (Leriche syndrome: aortoiliac occlusion).
In men, low libido and erectile dysfunction reflect gonadotropin deficiency.
Sexual / adrenal: Decreased libido, erectile dysfunction, loss of axillary/pubic hair, skin hyperpigmentation, salt craving — ACTH deficiency → adrenal insufficiency (fatigue, hyperpigmentation).
Autonomic: Urinary urgency/incontinence, constipation, erectile dysfunction — Spinal cord or brainstem involvement
*Sexual dysfunction?* — Sacral autonomic fibres run on the ventral surface of the cord; compression leads to neurogenic bladder/bowel and erectile dysfunction.
● Presents with: Fatigue and joint pain, Erectile dysfunction in\nmen and Amenorrhea in women, Skin darkening, Diabetes,
